properties.headline: Flood Advisory issued October 22 at 12:45PM PDT until October 22 at 2:00PM PDT by NWS San Diego CA
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues.

* WHERE...San Bernardino County in southern California...

* WHEN...Until 200 PM PDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.
Dangerous flows over low-water crossings.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 1245 PM PDT, Doppler radar and automated rain gauges indicated
heavy rain due to thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or
expected to begin shortly in the advisory area. Between 0.5 and
0.75 inches of rain have fallen.
- Additional rainfall amounts up to 0.5 inches are expected over
the area. This additional rain will result in minor flooding.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Highland, Running Springs, Hwy 18 Between Running Springs And Big
Bear, Angelus Oaks, Mountain Home Village, Hwy 18 Between Running
Springs And Skyforest, Hiwy 330 Between San Bernardino And
Running Springs and Seven Oaks.
- https://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

NWSheadline: FLOOD ADVISORY NOW IN EFFECT UNTIL 2 PM PDT THIS AFTERNOON
